create_dictionary_read_vocab: create a dictionary from a vocabulary file using the read_vocab static method
build_dictionary_index_data: build indexed sentence data from a text file using a dictionary for tokenization
test_dictionary_index: test the dictionary index method to look up word IDs with unknown word fallback
refactor_dictionary_max_vocab: refactor the dictionary max_vocab method to limit vocabulary size by top frequency words
review_dictionary_min_count: review the dictionary min_count method to filter words by minimum frequency threshold
